resources.string: Additional virtual display, as main display
Additional virtual display, PC display stays main
Display choice saved. It applies from the next stream.

Choose what this PC’s displays do while you stream from it. The PC’s own setting follows Host virtual display and the PC’s display settings. Virtual display only switches the PC’s monitors off during the stream. An additional virtual display keeps them on; as main display, games open on the virtual display. Physical display streams the PC’s monitor without a virtual display. The PC puts its displays back when the stream ends.\n\nThe choice needs Rubylight on the PC. Other hosts treat the virtual display choices like Host virtual display and ignore the rest.
